notes: Stable keys derive from exact UTF-8 Chinese source literals.
Model/object/bone/morph/group/material/file names and style identities remain user content.
Opt-in migration preserves bindings, icons and invariant units.
Composite templates use numbered .NET placeholders and are translated before inserting values.
Timeline view keys use explicit semantic Mda.Text.Context.Timeline.* IDs; they add no Chinese reverse-lookup aliases and are always addressed by key.
